Ilya (research): RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/2976543210 — brief summary + actions below. Please read and ack if you own anything. :mag:
Hannah (prod): TL;DR — subtle quality regression for long-form summarization prompts after a quantization profile change. Customers reported dropped sections / hallucinated dates. Impact window ~2026-06-18 11:02–11:44 UTC; affected ~3% of generation traffic on dedicated clusters running q8 profile.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Root cause: a new aggressive per-layer quantization threshold applied during the automatic quantization rollout (q8-fast) caused perturbation in positional embedding scaling for sequences >1k tokens. See section 2.3 in the doc for drift plots.
Ilya (research): Skim highlights for the thread:
```
Impact: degraded summary completeness & occasional hallucinated metadata for long documents (~3% of requests)
Root cause: per-layer quantization thresholding introduced in q8-fast rollout
Mitigation: rolled back q8-fast to q8-stable for affected clusters at 11:28 UTC
Customer notice: draft in ops, CS notified to triage priority customers
```
Sofia (customer-success): Customer signal: 4 tickets from high-touch accounts, 2 escalations — CS triaging; offering workarounds and temporary pin to q8-stable where possible.
Ilya (research): Action items (owner — due):
- Marcus: revert quantization rollout orchestration to block q8-fast auto-upgrades and add a preflight numeric-consistency check (PR + CI) — due 2026-06-22.
- Ilya: run a battery of long-sequence QA prompts with head-to-head comparisons (q8-fast vs q8-stable) and publish metrics to the RCA — due 2026-06-21.
- Hannah: finalize external customer note and coordinate outreach with CS (Sofia) — due 2026-06-19 10:00 PT.
- Sofia: contact the 2 escalated customers with timeline + offer for dedicated re-pin to q8-stable — due 2026-06-18 EOD.
- Ruth: review prioritization for longer-term fixes (better numeric checks + model-level quantization opt-in) in Monday exec planning — due 2026-06-20.
CI-Bot: Actions exported to tracker: https://redwood.internal/actions/2976543210 — please confirm ownership there.
Marcus (eng-runtime): Mitigations we applied: `quantizer.rollback(profile=q8-fast -> q8-stable, clusters=dedicated-*)`, incremental canary disabled for autoscale up of q8-fast. Deploy event: 2026-06-18 11:28 UTC (deploy-id: dpl-10234).
Ilya (research): Note: this regression did not affect embeddings pipelines or small-context interactive chat. It appears limited to long-sequence extractive/abstractive flows.
Hannah (prod): Office hours to walk through RCA & triage action items: 2026-06-19 16:00 PT — calendar: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/rca-2976543210-review
Sofia (customer-success): I'll paste the customer-facing wording into the draft by 2026-06-19 08:30 PT for ops review.
Ruth (vp-prod): Two asks: (1) confirm we have a rollback playbook for quantization rollouts, include an owner and SLA; (2) ensure CS messaging is explicit about which tenants were impacted and our remediation offers.
Marcus (eng-runtime): I'll add the rollback playbook to the runbook and tag Ilya for the numeric-check tests. ETA 2026-06-20.
Ilya (research): Please react with :white_check_mark: once you've read and accepted action items. I'll keep the tracker updated and follow up after office hours.
